description: A practical guide to the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan, sector layout, plot plans, payment types and current buyer verification steps.
intro: Explore the wider Phase 2 layout, compare six sector guides and find the right plan for checking a plot.
body:
## Master plan vs sector plan

The full Phase 2 master plan answers:

- Where is a sector located within the wider project?
- How do the major roads and sector areas connect?
- Which parts of the development sit near one another?

A dedicated sector plan answers:

- Where is a particular plot within that sector?
- What is the plot number and size?
- Is the plot on a corner or standard location?
- What road width or nearby open area is shown?
- How does the plot connect to the surrounding road network?

For an actual purchase decision, always use the correct sector plan rather than relying only on the full master plan.

## How to check a plot properly

Before shortlisting a plot, ask for the sector, plot number and size.

Then compare the plot against the relevant sector plan and check:

- Plot number
- Plot dimensions
- Road width
- Corner or standard position
- Nearby park or open space
- Main-road access
- Any applicable premium-location category

After that, confirm the current availability separately. A map may show a plot location, but it does not by itself prove that the plot is currently available for sale.

## Confirm current plot availability

The master plan and sector plans are planning references.

They can help you understand layout, plot position, roads and planned land uses. They should not be treated as a live inventory database.

For current inventory, ask for:

- Exact available plot number
- Current total payable amount
- Payment method
- Installment schedule, where applicable
- Any outstanding dues
- Special-location charges
- Booking or transfer requirements

[Check current Phase 2 availability](/faisal-town-phase-2/)

## Check current development on site

A master plan also does not show the current on-ground development condition.

Before buying, consider checking the actual location through a site visit or a recent live video.

Look for:

- Current road work
- Plot demarcation
- Access to the relevant sector
- Nearby construction
- Existing utilities
- Surrounding development

This helps separate the planned layout from the present on-ground condition.

## Areas shown on the wider plan

The wider planning material may also show areas such as Overseas, W and X.

Where no current inventory is being actively offered through this website, these should be treated as location references on the wider plan rather than promoted as currently available sales sections.

For current availability, ask before relying on an older map, brochure or marketing image.

## Before making any payment

Before making a material payment, verify:

- The correct sector and plot number
- Whether the sector is cash-only or installment based
- Current price or payment schedule
- Any outstanding dues
- Premium or special-location charges
- Current plot availability
- Payment recipient details
- Receipt and documentation procedure
- Current regulatory status with the relevant authority

Regulatory status can change over time. Do not rely only on dealer statements, screenshots or older marketing material. Check the latest authority record before making a final purchase decision.

[Check RDA housing-scheme information](https://rda.gop.pk/ahs/)

faqsText:
What is the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan? | It is the project-wide layout showing how the main Phase 2 sectors, roads and planned areas relate to one another. Use a dedicated sector plan when checking a specific plot.
What is the difference between the master plan and a sector plan? | The master plan is for overall project orientation. A sector plan is used for plot-level checking such as plot numbers, dimensions, roads and nearby planned areas.
Which Phase 2 sectors are covered on this website? | The current website covers Sector O, P, Q, R, S and T.
Which sectors are currently cash-only Model Blocks? | Sector O, Sector P, Sector Q and Sector R are currently presented as cash-only Model Blocks.
Which sectors currently have installment options? | Sector S and Sector T are currently presented as installment sectors.
What is the current Sector T starting price? | The confirmed 5.56 Marla Sector T entry price currently displayed on this website is PKR 27.90 Lac. Current availability and the payment schedule should be confirmed before payment.
Can the master plan confirm that a plot is available? | No. A master plan shows layout and planned areas. Current available plot numbers must be confirmed separately.
Does the master plan show current development? | No. Current roads, access, plot demarcation and surrounding development should be checked through a recent site visit or live update.
Should I verify regulatory status before buying? | Yes. Buyers should check the latest status directly with the relevant authority before making a material payment because regulatory records can change.
quickAnswer: Use the master plan for project-wide orientation and the dedicated sector plan for plot-level checks. Confirm availability, payment schedules, on-ground development and current regulatory status separately before payment.
